newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, off early highs.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed on Monday, retreating from early highs due to profit-taking selling ahead of the close, traders said.
The newly listed benchmark April contract settled at 139.8 yen per kg after opening at 141.2 yen. Other contracts ranged from 0.5 yen per kg lower to 1.6 yen higher.

Prices opened firmer, supported by the higher spot expiry last Friday and the yen's weakness against the dollar. But worries that price rises since the end of last week were too rapid prompted investors to take profits later in the day, sending the distant months into negative territory.
